summary: A user reported that a withdrawal of 0.00272744 BTC from NC Wallet remained pending for more than 100 hours despite payment of a priority network fee. No transaction identifier was generated and support stopped responding after initially attributing the delay to blockchain congestion.
user_mistake: stored BTC with a wallet service that controlled withdrawal processing
prevention: Test withdrawal functionality before maintaining a balance with a custodial wallet service / Keep only operational amounts with services controlling withdrawals
